# #2105: Patch: the board's colours come from one named palette
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

### What it does

The client uses hundreds of slightly different colours, which makes the screens look like many hands made them instead of one designer. Give the client one small, named colour palette and move the board's colours onto it, so every screen draws from the same set. Colours that carry meaning (your seat, the opponent's, legal, selected, Radiant) keep their meaning, and text stays readable.

### Acceptance

- The board's colours come from one named palette.
- New code can't quietly add one-off colours again.

### Blocked by, part of

_No response_
